description: This file contains a test suite for the 'git submodule absorbgitdirs' command. It sets up various submodule scenarios and verifies that the command correctly migrates embedded git directories of submodules into the superproject’s git directory structure. The tests cover basic usage, nested submodules, edge cases like de-initialized submodules, missing '.gitmodules' entries, and submodules with multiple worktrees.
